scope: Fresh Chrome DevTools interactions on retained PR65-bound WASM and three Git-bound assets. Browser plugin unavailable; no Playwright invoked. No fresh native SysON browser comparison in this pass.

steps.description: Stage package and inspect preview/commit controls
steps.health: Selected creation staging and focus work
Commit works; primary editing controls below initial viewport
Delivery gap: tab-local document cleared on reload, no effective exit guard

console: Only a favicon.ico 404 observed. App HTML/CSS/loader/WASM loaded without observed WASM runtime errors in these journeys. This is not a complete accessibility or usability study.

findings.title: Committed tab-local work is lost on reload with no effective exit guard
findings.head: 394b82a808f1650b63eeb2ef32516cc7ce99d4a8
findings.observed: Create/stage/commit ReviewVehicle, reload with beforeunload=dismiss; committed content1→0, no durable storage integration. Initial copy says tab-local; this is a product-delivery gap, not a broken advertised durable store.
tasks: Add an explicit dirty/durable-save state and unsaved-edit navigation guard before production use. Transaction commit must not imply durable save.
Wire actual durable project save/reopen and recovery; do not introduce a second model/store engine.
verification: Real create/edit/save/reload plus reload-before-save, new tab, browser back, interrupted persistence and reopen preserve the intended document/canvas/IDs or visibly refuse navigation.

findings.title: Mobile creation controls are more than one viewport below the primary screen
findings.head: 394b82a808f1650b63eeb2ef32516cc7ce99d4a8
findings.observed: At390×844 aftercommit, creationform starts y1216 and Stagecreation y1542; canvas/secondary controls occupy firstscreen. No horizontal overflow observed.
tasks: Design task-first responsive navigation with discoverable model/create/inspector access; preserve viewport and draft context.
Hide/disable inapplicable kind-specific creation controls; retain accessible labels and keyboard operation.
verification: 390×844,320px,desktop,200%zoom: create/select/edit/commit/cancel can be reached and completed with visible state/focus, no scroll trap or lost drafts.

findings.title: Unavailable history and canvas commands remain enabled
findings.head: 394b82a808f1650b63eeb2ef32516cc7ce99d4a8
findings.observed: Empty-start Undo/Redo and canvas undo/redo/cancel are visually enabled; after firstcommit Redo remains disabled=false despite empty redo history. States rely on error/no-op feedback.
tasks: Derive command availability from typed Rust state and expose disabled/busy/selection requirements consistently; do not infer by destructive trial actions.
verification: Initial/pending/committed/undo/redo/exhausted/stale/cancel states have correct enabled/disabled semantics and focus behavior; inapplicable actions do not produce misleading errors.

findings.title: Preview cap is checked after full rendering and fallback offers no export/recovery path
findings.head: 394b82a808f1650b63eeb2ef32516cc7ce99d4a8
evidence: Source render→html.len check at939-945; import replaces Editor and clears history at332-342; Canvas.scene serializes whole model even when current=None.
findings.observed: Input1MiB guard does not bound pretty/escaped HTML expansion. Full render allocates before16MiB check; fallback has only Undo. Import clears history before fallback, so an accepted expanding document can lose normal editing/export affordances. Large-browser trigger is proposed, not executed in this pass.
tasks: Bound serialization/render allocation before construction and admit new documents before replacing the active recoverable state.
Keep a non-rendering export/recover/discard route reachable after preview refusal.
verification: Dense/deep opaque metadata and escaped text below inputcap can never allocate unbounded preview or strand the session; refusal preserves prior model/drafts and export/recovery controls.
